name: Singapore University of Social Sciences
description: The Singapore University of Social Sciences is a public university in Clementi, Singapore, established in 2005 as SIM University and renamed and brought under the Ministry of Education as an Autonomous University in 2017. It focuses on the social sciences, business, law and lifelong learning, with both full-time and part-time degree programmes.
whyIncluded: One of Singapore's Ministry of Education (MOE)-funded Autonomous Universities, and the local option for social-science, business and part-time degrees that Singaporean students compare against overseas fees.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Information and Communication Technology
programmes.notes: Academic Year 2026 full-time fees, charged per course (5-cu course: SC S$820, PR S$1,363, non-ASEAN international S$2,081 incl. GST). SUSS's 'Estimated Total Fees Per Programme (For 4 Years)' for non-Accountancy programmes: SC S$30,200, PR S$50,400, ASEAN international S$68,400, all other international S$76,800, unsubsidised S$134,966; annual figure = 4-year total / 4. SC/PR fees exclude GST (subsidised by MOE); international fees include 9% GST. Compulsory fees = annual miscellaneous fee S$240 (SC/PR) or S$530 (international) plus 9% GST. SUSS says fees are reviewed annually and does not state that they are fixed per cohort. suss.edu.sg is behind a Cloudflare bot check, so the official page was read through a reader-proxy copy (r.jina.ai) rather than directly; no earlier years' figures are published.

programmes.name: Master of Analytics and Visualisation
programmes.notes: Whole-programme fee from SUSS's 'Year 2026/2027 Non-Subsidised Programme Fees (Graduate Programmes)' (updated Sept 2026): Master's Programme S$31,680 for Singapore Citizens/PRs and S$38,016 for other residents, both excluding GST; 9% GST added here (S$34,531.20 / S$41,437.44). Not MOE-subsidised (SSG subsidies for SC/PR not applied). 60 cu; international students take the accelerated track completed in 1 year, so the whole fee is taken as one year (SC/PR regular track is 1.5-4 years). Compulsory fees = annual miscellaneous fee S$20 (SC/PR/other residents) or S$530 (international Student's Pass holders) plus 9% GST. The PDF's footnote still says 'Fees are accurate as of 15 Apr 2024' although it is headed Year 2026/2027 and dated September 2026. Re-read on 2026-09-30 through a reader-proxy copy (r.jina.ai) because suss.edu.sg blocks automated access.
